patch_description:
This version replaces the layer-by-layer Python greedy loops with two batched tensor algorithms.

For replication, it uses an exact discrete waterline formulation: the value of assigning an expert its k-th replica is `load / k`. Selecting the globally largest redundant replica waterlines per layer minimizes the largest per-replica logical-expert load under the fixed replica budget. This computes all replica counts with one batched `topk`, rather than repeatedly running a maximum reduction once per redundant expert.

For node and GPU placement, it uses batched antitone slot packing. Experts are sorted by load, then processed in pack-sized rounds. In every round, the currently heaviest items are paired with the currently lightest packs, while preserving the exact number of experts assigned to every pack. This is a vectorized largest-processing-time-style balancing heuristic, avoids per-layer Python work, and directly respects fixed GPU capacity.

The hierarchy and output contract remain unchanged: group locality is retained whenever groups divide nodes, while the fallback remains global balancing.
